info.title: SOCUD API
info.description: REST API of the SOCUD knowledge base. Real-time editing runs over a separate Hocuspocus WebSocket and is not part of this document.

bearer.description: Short-lived access token from POST /auth/login or /auth/refresh.

refresh-cookie.name: socud_refresh
refresh-cookie.description: httpOnly refresh-token cookie (path /auth) set by login/refresh; send with credentials.

message.description: A single message, or the list of validation messages for 400 responses.

access_token.description: Short-lived JWT for the `Authorization: Bearer` header.

restored.description: Documents restored: the document plus descendants archived with it, or the documents archived together with the space.

yjsState.description: Raw Yjs state (JSON-serialised Buffer). Internal; do not rely on it.

draftHtml.description: Draft HTML projection of the collaborative state. Internal; may be large.

draftText.description: Draft plain-text projection of the collaborative state. Internal; may be large.

publishedVersion.description: Number of the last publish (0 = never published through the versioned flow).

embeddedVersion.description: Published version whose chunks are fully embedded; null = never embedded.

group.description: Space id, used to colour nodes by space.

truncated.description: True when more readable documents existed than `limit`: the graph shows the most recently updated ones.

snippet.description: PLAIN TEXT (never HTML): render it as text.

score.description: Cosine similarity in 0..1 of the best chunk for semantic matches, otherwise null.

rrfScore.description: Reciprocal-rank-fusion value the results are ordered by (not a percentage).

isArchived.description:
Whether the document is in the trash. Archived documents are hidden from everyone on this
route (404), so a successful read always reports `false` today; the field lets clients rely on
the flag instead of assuming it.

spaceId.description: Space the document belongs to (lets the client link back to it).

html.description:
Optional and only a fallback: Publish renders the HTML from the document's Yjs state on the
server. Used (after sanitizing) only for documents that have no Yjs state yet.

version.description: Number of the version that was just published.

embeddingQueued.description: False when Redis was unavailable; the embedding is picked up later by the reconcile job.

chunks.description: Chunks with a vector produced by this model.

profile.description: Active embedding profile (EMBEDDING_PROFILE), or null when none is selected.

activeModel.description: Vector space the active provider produces from now on.

stored.description: Models present in the index, largest first. Chunks without a vector are not counted.

mismatch.description: True when the index holds vectors of a model other than the active one.

recommendedActions.description: Human-readable remedies; empty when there is no mismatch.
